newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Berkeley, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Berkeley, Calif..

text.p: OTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the City of Berkeley, intends to offer for public sale on Wednesday, June 18, 1997

(or on such subsequent Wednesday as is communicated by the Clerk of the City of Berkeley through Bloomberg's Financial News Wire no less than 24 hours in advance), at the hour of 9:00 a.m., California time, at the office of Brown & Wood LLP, 555 California Street, 50th Floor, San Francisco, California 94104 $10,500,000* principal amount of general obligation bonds of the City designated

1997 General Obligation Bonds (Election of 1992, Series C)'' (the Bonds''). Within 24 hours, the ector of Finance of the City will consider the bids received and, if an acceptable bid is received, award the sale of the Bonds on the basis of the true interest cost. In the event that no bid is awarded by the designated time, proposals will be received the following Wednesday at the same time and place specified above and each Wednesday thereafter until such time as a bid is awarded or notice to the contrary is given. NOTICE IS HEREBY FURTHER GIVEN that the Bonds, dated July 1, 1997, will be offered for public sale subject to the terms and conditions of the Official Notice of Sale. An Official Statement and an Official Notice of Sale relating to the Bonds will be furnished upon request to Project Finance Associates, LLC, 1491 Indian Valley Road, Novato, California 94947, telephone: (415) 897-9943, the financial advisor to the City for the Bonds.
